WITH w AS (
  SELECT f.*, s.store_id, o.status, o.login_state, o.fulfilment_type, o.member_key AS o_member_key
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE f.channel_id IN (2,3) AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-22' AND DATE '2026-03-22')
SELECT store_id, status, login_state, staff_purchase_flag, (member_key IS NULL) nomem, (o_member_key IS NULL) o_nomem, (status IS NULL) noorder,
 count(*) n, count(DISTINCT receipt_id||'-'||line_no) distinct_lines, sum(net_amount) net, min(net_amount) mn, min(quantity) minq, min(etl_loaded_at) e1, max(etl_loaded_at) e2
FROM w GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

WITH sales AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, f.net_amount,
         (f.member_key IS NOT NULL) AS raw_member,
         (coalesce(f.member_key, o.member_key) IS NOT NULL) AS fixed_member
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE f.channel_id IN (2,3) AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (9,10,11)),
s AS (SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, sum(net_amount) tot, sum(CASE WHEN raw_member THEN net_amount END) raw_m, sum(CASE WHEN fixed_member THEN net_amount END) fix_m, count(*) n FROM sales GROUP BY 1,2),
r AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, sum(r.refund_net) tot_ref,
         sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(f.member_key, o.member_key) IS NOT NULL THEN r.refund_net END) mem_ref, count(*) n_ret, count(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) n_ret_d
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
  WHERE f.channel_id IN (2,3) AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (9,10,11)
  GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT s.*, r.tot_ref, r.mem_ref, r.n_ret, r.n_ret_d,
 round(100*raw_m/tot,3) raw_share, round(100*fix_m/tot,3) fixed_share,
 round(100*(fix_m-coalesce(mem_ref,0))/(tot-coalesce(tot_ref,0)),3) fixed_net_of_returns_share
FROM s LEFT JOIN r USING (fiscal_year, fiscal_period) ORDER BY 2

WITH sales AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, f.net_amount,
         (coalesce(f.member_key, o.member_key) IS NOT NULL) AS is_member
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  WHERE f.channel_id IN (2, 3) AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (9, 10, 11)),
refunds AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, -r.refund_net AS net_amount,
         (coalesce(f.member_key, o.member_key) IS NOT NULL) AS is_member
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
  WHERE f.channel_id IN (2, 3) AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (9, 10, 11)),
all_lines AS (SELECT * FROM sales UNION ALL SELECT * FROM refunds)
SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period,
       round(100 * sum(CASE WHEN is_member THEN net_amount END) / sum(net_amount), 1) AS member_share_of_web_net_sales_pct
FROM all_lines GROUP BY fiscal_year, fiscal_period ORDER BY fiscal_period
